issue_snapshot.title: Follow-ups from #5: 4 from the review, 1 from QA
issue_snapshot.body:
What the review and QA of PR #16 (for #5) found and did not fix there — filed as it merged, one ticket for the lot.

## From the review

Non-blocking findings the reviewer approved despite: a statement about severity, not a judgement that they are wrong.

### AC-4 and the PR QA script require the rename flow to sit behind an explicit confirm naming the object, but RenameGroupForm saves on one click with no confirm step.

> AC-4 and the PR QA script require the rename flow to sit behind an explicit confirm naming the object, but RenameGroupForm saves on one click with no confirm step.
> 
> `components/groups-panels.tsx:196`
> 
> Evidence: git show origin/sdlc/issue-5:components/groups-panels.tsx | grep -n ConfirmStep shows confirm usages at lines 375, 388 (rotate/disable), 452 (remove), 485 (archive), 579 (leave) — none inside RenameGroupForm (lines 196-236), which renders only a Save name button. Work-order AC-4 check: 'Rename, remove-member, archive and leave flows each require an explicit confirm naming the object'. Counter-evidence: docs/ui.md destructive-actions pattern lists remove/rotate/disable/archive (not rename), so the code matches the spec while the AC text over-requires.
> 
> Fix: Either add a ConfirmStep naming the group to RenameGroupForm, or (more consistent with ui.md, where rename is not a destructive action) amend AC-4 and the QA script to require confirms only for remove/archive/leave/rotate/disable.

### The diff adds three files the work order never lists — app/not-found.tsx, lib/groups/queries.ts, lib/money/format.ts — so strictly they are unreviewed changes, even though each is defensible.

> The diff adds three files the work order never lists — app/not-found.tsx, lib/groups/queries.ts, lib/money/format.ts — so strictly they are unreviewed changes, even though each is defensible.
> 
> Evidence: gh pr diff 16 --name-only lists 25 files; work-order.json files[] plus tests[] cover 22 of them. The three extras: app/not-found.tsx (the one shared 404 AC-1/AC-2 depend on, yet no work-order entry creates it), lib/groups/queries.ts (listGroupsForUser/listMembers/findGroupByInviteToken read helpers), lib/money/format.ts (formatMinorUnits, whose only call sites render literal 0 balances pending TR-9).
> 
> Fix: Amend the work order files[] to list all three — the shared 404 and the single listing-query module are the right call — and either keep format.ts as the render-time formatter seam or fold its one function away until TR-9 puts real amounts behind it.

### isUniqueViolation is copy-pasted between lib/auth/actions.ts and lib/groups/actions.ts instead of shared: both define UNIQUE_VIOLATION, DUPLICATE_KEY_MESSAGE, MAX_ERROR_CAUSES and the same .cause-walk, and the groups copy's own comment admits it ('The same walk as lib/auth/actions.ts'). The v2 debate unified the duplicate CSPRNG generator behind lib/random.ts but left this twin in place, so the next driver error-shape fix has two places to land and the double-claim race mapping AC-9 relies on can silently diverge from the signup one.

The v2 debate unified the duplicate CSPRNG generator behind lib/random.ts but left this twin in place, so the next driver error-shape fix has two places to land and the double-claim race mapping AC-9 relies on can silently diverge from the signup one.
> 
> `lib/groups/actions.ts:62`
> 
> Evidence: git show origin/sdlc/issue-5:lib/groups/actions.ts lines 53-77 and lib/auth/actions.ts lines 37-60 define the identical walker; git grep shows the only two definitions in the repo.
> 
> Fix: Move the walker to a shared module (e.g. lib/db/errors.ts) and import it from both action modules.

### AuthForm renders a hidden `next` input that nothing reads: the auth actions never reference `next` (no occurrence in lib/auth/actions.ts), and the invite-link-survives-auth landing actually works through the page's own searchParams plus router.refresh() re-render. The prop, the input and its comment are dead weight on the sign-in/sign-up forms.

The prop, the input and its comment are dead weight on the sign-in/sign-up forms.
> 
> `components/auth-form.tsx:75`
> 
> Evidence: git grep for next consumers over origin/sdlc/issue-5 returns zero readers; components/auth-form.tsx:75 renders the input while lib/auth/actions.ts contains no 'next' reference outside next/* imports.
> 
> Fix: Delete the hidden input and the `next` prop (the page already redirects from its own validated query string), or thread it through the action if a future flow needs it server-side.

## Found by QA — pre-existing

PR #16 did not introduce these, which is why they did not block it.

### Missing favicon logs 404 console noise on every page

**Severity** trivial (as judged by QA — reassess before planning).

**Expected.**
> No console errors on a clean page load; a valid icon or no request at all.

**Actual.**
> Every page load logs 'Failed to load resource: 404' for /favicon.ico (server returns HTTP 404, confirmed by direct GET). Cosmetic console noise only; no UI impact.

**Steps to reproduce**
1. Open any page of the preview (e.g. /) with devtools console open
2. Observe two 404 resource errors for /favicon.ico on every navigation

**Reproducible:** always

---

**Check each one still reproduces before planning it.** They were written against the PR as it stood, and a later round can have fixed one. Some may not hold up: say so and drop them rather than implementing something that was never wrong. Split this if they turn out to be unrelated.
